name: Iowa

creditorClaims.text: Claims are barred unless filed with the clerk within the later of 4 months after the second publication of the notice to creditors or, for reasonably ascertainable creditors, 1 month after notice is mailed (Iowa Code § 633.410).

earliestClose.text: Final settlement must be made within 3 years after the second publication of the notice to creditors unless the court orders otherwise (Iowa Code § 633.473); no earlier date is fixed beyond the 4-month claims bar of § 633.410.

smallEstate.text: Distribution by affidavit 40 days after death when the gross value of the decedent's personal property passing by will or intestacy is $50,000 or less and there is no real property, and no administration is pending (Iowa Code § 633.356). Not indexed.

simplified.text: Administration of small estates under Iowa Code chapter 635 when gross probate assets in Iowa do not exceed $200,000: letters are issued by the clerk on petition (Iowa Code § 635.1).

filingFee.text: Clerk court costs equal to 0.2% of the value of the probate assets listed in the report and inventory (Iowa Code § 633.31(3)); non-probate assets such as joint tenancy property and beneficiary-designated accounts are excluded.

personalRepFee.text: Reasonable fees set by the court, not exceeding 6% of the first $1,000, 4% from $1,000 to $5,000 and 2% above $5,000 of the gross assets listed in the probate inventory (life insurance excluded unless payable to the estate) (Iowa Code § 633.197); extra allowances for extraordinary services (Iowa Code § 633.199).

attorneyFee.text: Reasonable fee set by the court, not exceeding the personal representative schedule of § 633.197 (Iowa Code § 633.198), plus extraordinary services (Iowa Code § 633.199).

uncertain: Date the $50,000 affidavit limit took effect is not shown in the 2026 Iowa Code text; smallEstate.effective = null (section last amended by 2025 Acts ch 148, retroactive to January 1, 2025).
